name: Waller Assistance & Restoration Ministries (WARM) Food Pantry
hours: Tuesday–Thursday 10 a.m.–3 p.m. The website says first-time visitors must arrive no later than 2 p.m. to meet with a caseworker.
offering: WARM Food Pantry distributes frozen and canned meats, canned vegetables, bread, fresh produce and other food to families in need.
eligibility: The official page says TEFAP eligibility requires either qualifying benefits (SNAP, TANF, SSI, NSLP, or non-institutional Medicaid) or household income at or below 185% of federal poverty guidelines. First-time visitors must register with a caseworker and bring proof of qualifying benefits or household income, proof of residence, and government-issued ID for each adult. Annual eligibility recertification is required.
notes: Official Food Pantry page identifies the service and hours and gives the physical address and phone. Census Geocoder Public_AR_Current returned no address match for the published address or tested street-name variants. Coordinates remain null; TX-10 point-in-polygon membership has not been established, so this candidate is not claimed to be inside the district.
